title: WAC 296-17-920, Assessment for supplemental pension fund

passages.question: How much supplemental pension may be retained from each worker in 2026?
passages.excerpt: The amount of 95.6 mils ($0.0956) shall be retained by each employer from the earnings of each worker for each hour or fraction thereof the worker is employed. The amount of money so retained from the employee shall be matched in an equal amount by each employer ... WSR 25-24-041, filed 11/26/25, effective 1/1/26
